spans.text: # CP-L10 — Ares Capital Corporation
## Request

View: Ares Capital Corporation's historical FY2024/FY2023 evidence warrants targeted financial, fundamental, funding, market and document follow-up. Higher net investment income and positive published asset coverage are meaningful counterevidence to an immediate funding-closure thesis; they do not establish recurring cash realization, drawable facilities, adequate security compensation or current compliance. Complete all five internal screens, in order, within this single screening-only handoff.

Run `sol-remaining-arcc-lite-20261105`; issuer_id ARCC; module CP-L10; method deploy-v-r14; public / credit_snapshot. Reporting anchor 2024-12-31; actual paid model execution 2026-11-05. Annual comparisons are full calendar years, not quarters. Historical source admission was executed 2026-11-04; annual audit date in that lineage is 2025-02-05. January/February 2025 disclosures are subsequent events, not December resources or present November 2026 conditions. This is an ex-post historical screen, not an information-availability backtest.

`decision_scope: SCREENING_ONLY`. Five-screen method selected from the CP-OS archive: financial change, fundamental credit, liquidity/forward risk, market/protection, legal/capacity triage. All four alternate commands resolve to this complete owner workflow; routing is not proof of analytical execution. This artifact performs analytical schema checking, not native invocation/profile acceptance. Source-owner columns identify analytical responsibilities, not accepted full-owner runs. SOURCE_DIRECT/MIXED admission does not require fabricated full CP-1/CP-2 heads.
